editorial:
When a heavily armed group takes over a packed football stadium during a major match, an ex-soldier named Michael Knox finds himself in the middle of a nightmare. He is there to watch the game with Danni, the daughter of a fallen comrade, when the terrorists lock down the building and threaten thousands of fans. With no backup and no way out, Michael has to use every skill he learned in the military to protect Danni and stop the bad guys before time runs out. The movie has a fun, old-school action vibe that feels like a throwback to the Die Hard era, with plenty of fights, explosions, and tense moments inside the stadium.

Dave Bautista is solid as the tough but caring hero, and the action scenes are well staged with good energy. The pacing keeps things moving, though some of the dialogue is a bit cheesy and the villains are not very memorable. Still, if you enjoy simple, no-nonsense action movies with a likable lead, this one delivers. It is a great pick for a weekend movie night. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Michael fights his way to the stadium roof where the terrorist leader is trying to escape by helicopter. After a brutal hand-to-hand fight, Michael kills the leader and stops the helicopter from taking off. The bomb threat is neutralized, the stadium is saved, and the crowd is evacuated safely. Michael reunites with Danni, who is unharmed, and the two walk out together as heroes, having survived the deadly takeover.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-school action thrillers with a tough hero
